sources.entry: clawpypaste - Menu bar block picker and session browser for Claude Code. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/krisbradley/clawpypaste) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app that lists grabbable blocks (code, tool output, paths, URLs, messages, tables) from your active Claude Code session so you can click to copy them.
summary.what_it_does: clawpypaste is a macOS menu bar app that reads the session JSONL files Claude Code writes under ~/.claude/projects/ and extracts blocks such as fenced code, markdown tables, file paths, URLs, tool output, whole messages and sections. Blocks are shown in a popover where you can select with arrow keys and press Return to copy, or drag a block into another app. Right-click menus offer extras such as copy as rich text, copy without markdown, pretty JSON, copy as TSV/CSV, wrapping as a code fence, and running shell commands in Terminal or iTerm2 with a confirmation for destructive commands. It also has a history mode across all sessions, pinning, a detached window, and a CLI (last, search, paste, list, kinds) for shell scripts. The README says the basic features need no accessibility prompts; only "Inject into Claude prompt" needs Accessibility permission.
use_cases: copy code from Claude Code output without mouse-selecting wrapped lines
browse and reuse earlier blocks from past Claude Code sessions
paste AI output as rich text into Google Docs or Word
copy markdown tables as TSV or CSV into spreadsheets
pipe the latest code block into a file from a shell script
remove AI-typical phrasing from prose before posting
how_to_run: git clone <repo URL> && cd clawpypaste && make install
notable: Reads Claude Code's existing session JSONL files, so it needs no terminal scraping or plugins
Block extraction covers code, tables, paths, URLs, tool I/O, messages and sections, with deduplication by content hash
Rich text, plain-text, TSV/CSV and humanized copy variants for different destinations
Right-click Run in new Terminal with confirmation for destructive commands
Ships as a notarized, Developer ID signed universal binary with a CLI
caveats: Only works with Claude Code session files on disk; depends on their JSONL format
Inject into Claude prompt requires Accessibility permission on first use
